explanation: Traverse in order to produce sorted keys. The BST property lets us skip the left subtree below the lower bound and the right subtree above the upper bound. Endpoints are included.
timeComplexity: O(h + m) for height h and m returned keys in a BST with distinct keys; O(n) worst case.
spaceComplexity: O(h) recursion stack, plus O(m) output.
